review.recommendation: No blocking defect identified in the two controller deltas. Selectively intake the Groups100 controller and exact-count wrapper gate with their immutable original evidence. This is source/admission readiness, not native execution or final performance acceptance.

groups100.installation: Only an explicit retained successful original v40 installer result and the same owned shut-down iPadOS27 simulator are admitted. Original installation receipts remain source-bound; current app/test/SDK images are independently checked before and after.
groups100.sourceBinding: Frozen original source context plus exact current tracked Groups100 driver blob, current same-checkout qualified Debug images, and before/after source/build comparisons remain required.
groups100.actualRSS: The host resolves the installed app executable and unique PID, then asks Darwin ps for actual RSS at each operation boundary. Each begin/end pair is identity-bound; 100 completed records and 200 distinct acknowledged nonces are mandatory.
groups100.originalMetrics: Each end must match exactly one original NativeGroupSwitchPerformance row by owner/scene/group/document/revision interval and actual PID. Operation UUIDs are unique, sequences contiguous and launchID unchanged. Original elapsedSeconds and phys_footprint bytes stay separate from host RSS and automation delay.
groups100.coldProof: Exactly one attachment from the selected case and owned device must bind namespace, corpus/catalog/installation hashes and current container. Pre-cold PID equals the operation cohort; post-cold PID differs and request UUID is fresh; profile/group/document/canonical locator survive, revision never retreats. Cold scene identity may legitimately change.
groups100.failureBehavior: Missing/ambiguous metrics, partial cohort, wrong native case/device, skips, failed export, active/failed observer, changed source/images/database/receipts or failed retained shutdown prevents acceptance. The observer must stop before simulator shutdown.
groups100.controlBoundary: The37 Oracle controls exercise actual operation matching, cold-field validation and exported-attachment admission using explicit synthetic records plus the original bounded-file reader. They do not run GroupRSSHost against a real process, measure RSS, execute a UI operation or prove cold restoration. LOCAL37 is preserved under its older common-core hash; it is not relabelled as the newer core run.
groups100.metricLimit: These are boundary RSS/footprint observations, not continuous peak RSS, a performance SLA, final Native116/Release114 or physical-device acceptance.

exactCount.scope: The new gate runs only after the v40 execute entry point's original controller completes. Source-check and reusable load_core consumers retain their previous separate scopes.
exactCount.requirements: Exactly3 scales, requested and actual values are true integers and exactly [100,500,2000], each scale has its own distinct observationID contained in the full original observation set, per-scale/global exact flags and original at-least flag all agree.
exactCount.originalObservationAuthority: The unchanged common controller first binds the complete observation-ID set to its actual Inspector records, verifies all9 original exploration outcomes, and derives cached counts/exact flags from original recorded UI/cache observations. The new gate does not manufacture those observations.
exactCount.receiptBehavior: Original full-v40 successful UI status, explicit owned simulator UUID, nonempty source attribution, unchanged database/source/images and successful cleanup are required. A separate nonoverwritable MET/NOT_MET receipt binds original receipt hashes and the observed source/UDID; NOT_MET raises failure. Original result/scales bytes remain intact.
exactCount.preservation: The64-line function and2-line execute hook are insertion-only. Removing them recovers the old wrapper byte for byte. Common v32 source, original native test files and strict zero-skip/declaration verifiers are untouched.
exactCount.controlBoundary: All17 source-only controls bind the exact wrapper hash and check rejection plus original input-byte preservation; their host receipt data is explicitly synthetic. No natural exact100/500/2000 target, rendered row-body coverage, latency/RSS SLA or native app result is established by those controls.
